help:
❓ How it works

✍️ Confess — pick a category, send your text, confirm. A moderator reviews it; it appears in the channel as #N and you are notified.
📝 My confessions — status of what you sent, delete your own posts.
📢 Advertise — buy a sponsored post.
📜 Rules — what is allowed; request a takedown.

Commands: /delete <number> · /lang · /cancel

Everything is anonymous: your Telegram ID is never stored.
submit.send_text: Send your confession as text ({min}–{max} characters). No names, links or phone numbers.
submit.closed: Submissions are closed right now. Please try again later.
submit.closed_hours: Submissions are open {hours}. Please come back then.
submit.queue_full: The review queue is full. Please try again tomorrow.
submit.cooldown: Please wait {minutes} more minute(s) before sending another confession.
submit.daily_cap: You have reached today's limit of {cap} confessions.
submit.blocked: ⚠️ Your text contains words that are not allowed.
notify.rejected: Your confession was not approved. Reason: {reason}
notify.banned: You have been banned from submitting until {until}.
delete.not_yours: That confession is not yours or does not exist.
comments.title: 💬 Comments on #{number} ({count})
comments.empty: No comments yet. Be the first!
takedown.ask_number: Which confession number should be taken down?
takedown.sent: Thanks. Moderators will review your request within 24 hours.
takedown.invalid: Please send a valid confession number.
ads.disabled: Advertising is not available right now.
ads.send_photo: Send a photo for the ad, or tap Skip.
ads.bad_url: That link is not allowed. Use a full https:// link (no shorteners or invite links).
ads.preview: ☝️ That is how your ad will look.
ads.no_accounts: Payment is not available right now. Please contact an admin.
ads.pick_bank: Which account did you pay to?
ads.ask_reference: Send the transaction/reference number from your {bank} receipt.
ads.ask_suffix: Also send the last {n} digits of the account you paid FROM.
ads.ask_phone: Also send the phone number you paid from (09…).
ads.verified: ✅ Payment confirmed. Your ad is in review — usually within 24 hours.
ads.queued: Your payment is being checked. We will message you when it is confirmed.
ads.failed: We could not verify that reference. Please check it and try again ({left} attempt(s) left).
ads.underpaid: The receipt shows {amount} ETB but the order is {price} ETB. An admin will review it.
ads.needs_review: We could not confirm this automatically. An admin will check it and get back to you.
ads.expired: Order #{ad_id} expired because payment was not received.
ads.approved: Your ad #{ad_id} was approved and is scheduled.
ads.rejected: Your ad #{ad_id} was not approved. Reason: {reason}. A refund will be arranged.
ads.photo_only: Please send a photo or tap Skip.
ads.bad_reference: That does not look like a valid reference. Please send only the reference code.
nav.unknown: That isn't a command. Use the buttons below — tap ✍️ Confess to send a confession.

mine.title: 📝 Your recent confessions
mine.empty: You haven't sent any confessions yet. Tap ✍️ Confess to start.
ads.contact_ask: Write your message for the admins about order #{ad_id} (one message):

ads.contact_cooldown: Please wait before sending another message.
ads.too_many_open: You already have unpaid orders. Pay or cancel them in /myads before placing a new one.
takedown.cooldown: You recently sent a takedown request. Please wait a bit before sending another.
submit.preview_hint: This is how it will appear in the channel.

ads.pay_to: Pay to one of these accounts (tap a number to copy):
ads.pay_then: Then tap “I have paid” and send the transaction reference.
ads.none_yet: You have no ads yet. Tap 📢 Advertise to start.
connect.not_op: Only the author of this confession can ask to connect.
connect.cooldown: Please wait {minutes} minute(s) before another request.
connect.already: You already asked this commenter. Waiting for their answer.
connect.unreachable: That commenter can't be reached right now.
connect.sent: 📇 Request sent to {alias}. If they agree, you'll be able to open their profile. They will not see who you are.
connect.ask:
📇 The author of confession #{number} would like to contact you about your comment:

“{comment}”

Share your Telegram contact with them? Only they receive it — you won't see who they are unless they message you. You can change your mind later.
connect.accepted_target: ✅ You agreed to share your contact for #{number}. You can still revoke it within {hours} hours.
connect.revoked_target: Revoked. The author has been told not to contact you.
connect.target_withdrawn: The author of #{number} withdrew their request. Nothing was shared.
connect.target_refused: The author of #{number} decided not to connect. Your contact was not opened.
connect.target_revealed: The author of #{number} opened your profile. You can still revoke within {hours} hours.
connect.op_declined: {alias} on #{number} declined to share their contact.
connect.op_accepted: 📇 {alias} on #{number} agreed to share their contact. Open it now, or decline if you changed your mind.
connect.refused: Okay — their contact was not opened.
connect.revealed: 👤 {alias} on #{number}. Be kind — they can withdraw this.
connect.op_revoked_before: {alias} on #{number} changed their mind. Their contact was not shared.
connect.op_revoked_after: ⚠️ {alias} on #{number} revoked their contact. Please do not contact them.
connect.gone: This request is no longer valid.
nav.staff_hint_moderator: You're a moderator — tap 📋 Queue to review confessions.
nav.staff_hint_admin: You're an admin — 📋 Queue to review, ⚙️ Admin to configure.
